Game Overview

In Ghost Sniper, the core idea is straightforward: immerse yourself in Ghost Sniper, where stealth and precision are your greatest allies. As an elite sniper, thread through over 30 intense levels, executing flawless silent takedowns. Master your environments, strategize with skill, and become the ultimate shadow in this thrilling shooter adventure. Can you handle the suspense?
